hypothesis: a larger HEK293/HEK293T promoter-autonomy sequence-activity cohort exists that can raise target-domain supervision above the batch21 from-scratch gate
criterion: >=1000 usable sequence-activity rows AND >=500 independent sequence/locus groups with measured cell-specific promoter activity and defined sequences

reused_retrospective_reference.title: A single-cell massively parallel reporter assay detects cell type specific cis-regulatory activity (scMPRA core-promoter library)
reused_retrospective_reference.role: clearly REUSED retrospective reference (batch22 cohort); NOT a new independent study
reused_retrospective_reference.sequence_definition: Haberle et al. 2019 hg19 133 bp core promoter
reused_retrospective_reference.cell: HEK293 (series is a HEK293+K562 mixture; processed file reports per-cell-type exp)
reused_retrospective_reference.note: 674 of 676 members usable after the 3 SCP1 mutants; the K562 columns are measurements of the SAME sequences -> extra rows do NOT add independent sequence groups (669 total)

assessment.download_state: INCOMPLETE (5.7 MB of 33 MB; corrupt/truncated gzip retained for honesty)
assessment.reason: the only processed supplementary for GSE245191 is the promoter-ARCHITECTURE/positional-effects table (5 fixed control promoters minP/UBCp/EEF1A1p/noP/Pgk1p); the 0.3k/10k/30k promoter-library samples exist only as raw sequence data with no processed sequence-activity table and no sequence definitions
heavily-barcoded counts for 5 FIXED CONTROL promoters (noP/minP/UBCp/Pgk1P/eef1aP) only -- not a sequence-varied promoter library; no sequence column; cannot yield >=1000 sequence-activity rows

assessment.title: Systematic evaluation of the impact of promoter proximal short tandem repeats on gene expression
assessment.assay: transient plasmid MPRA, GFP reporter, cDNA/gDNA barcode ratio, 3 replicates
assessment.reason: library = synthetic promoter variants carrying variable STR copy number/motif; the target is an STR-driven reporter effect, not the autonomous activity of a natural promoter sequence. Transient HEK293T plasmid context is closer to the local constructs, but the design is variant-effect and cannot be silently pooled.

assessment.title: Genome-wide mapping of autonomous promoter activity in human cells (SuRE)
assessment.assay: SuRE: random 0.2-2 kb genomic fragments, plasmid, autonomous transcription, barcoded, 2 biological replicates
assessment.reason: K562 only in this series, not HEK293/HEK293T; processed counts are 1.1 GB + multi-GB bigWigs, exceeding the processed-download bound without a HEK file.

conclusion: No coherent HEK293/HEK293T promoter-AUTONOMY sequence-activity cohort with >=1000 usable rows and >=500 independent sequence groups was obtainable within the bound. The two HEK293T bulk-MPRA processed tables (GSE245191, GSE217680) contain only 5 fixed control promoters each; the large HEK293T promoter library samples exist only as raw sequence data with no processed sequence-activity table and no sequence definitions; the HEK293T STR library (GSE306816) is a repeat-variant design, not promoter autonomy; SuRE (GSE78709) is K562.
what_this_does_not_prove: It does NOT prove that data volume is the binding constraint.
It does NOT prove cell transfer must fail.
It does NOT lower or raise the batch21 from-scratch gate; the 673 reused rows are retained.
